_comment: Who may access which client. Keys are verified user IDs: the signed-in Google email in production (IAP), or ASTROBOT_DEV_USER ('user') in local dev mode. Anyone not listed has no access. An empty list means no clients, never all clients.
_guests_comment: Clients that anonymous visitors may use when the app runs with ASTROBOT_AUTH_MODE=public (public demo link). Ignored in every other mode.
